prompt: Announce the First Baptist church potluck as a WWE ring announcer. Full commitment.
response:
LLLLLLADIES AND GENTLEMEN… BOYS AND GIRLS… CHURCH FAMILY OF ALL AGES…

LIVE! This Sunday… immediately following the morning service… from the fellowship hall at FIRST BAPTIST CHURCH…

IT’S THE MOST ELECTRIFYING MEAL IN COMMUNITY HISTORY…

THE FIRST BAPTIST CHURCH POTLUUUUUUCK!

In this corner… weighing in at three full casserole dishes… with a perfect record of zero leftovers… BROTHER JIM’S WORLD-FAMOUS CHEESY HASHBROWN BAKE!

And in the opposite corner… coming in hot, covered in foil, and undefeated at every family gathering… SISTER LINDA’S GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE!

Prepare yourselves for a no-holds-barred showdown featuring fried chicken… deviled eggs… macaroni salad… crockpots of mystery and glory… and desserts so powerful they may require a second prayer!

Bring your best dish… bring your appetite… bring a friend… and bring the kind of stretchy waistband that says, “I came here for fellowship AND victory!”

But remember, church family: this is a potluck, so don’t come walking down that aisle empty-handed unless you’re prepared to tap out to hunger!

Sunday after service… First Baptist Fellowship Hall…

Where the plates are stacked… the tea is sweet… and the glory of the Lord meets the power of potato salad!

CAN I GET AN AMEN?!
